about.greeting: I'm Rachit Srivastava, a Software Developer focused on backend engineering, full-stack development, and building AI-powered applications.
about.intro: I build full-stack applications and AI-powered solutions, working with backend systems, REST APIs, RAG pipelines, LLMs, and vector search.
about.education: Currently pursuing a B.Tech in Electrical Engineering at Shri G.S. Institute of Science and Technology (SGSITS), Indore.
about.philosophy: I enjoy exploring new technologies and turning ideas into practical products, combining strong engineering principles with the possibilities of AI.

points: Built 10+ pages of an esports platform UI using React and JavaScript, implementing lazy loading to reduce initial bundle size; the platform supported 1,500+ user registrations.
Integrated REST APIs to display live tournament data and created responsive layouts using CSS Flexbox and Grid for mobile, tablet and desktop.
Created 15+ reusable components using React and Tailwind CSS; applied useMemo and useCallback to avoid unnecessary component re-renders.

projects.name: RuleLens
projects.description: Built a closed-domain Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) application using FastAPI, PostgreSQL, pgvector and 384-dimensional BGE embeddings. Achieved 95.83% accuracy (46/48 queries) on a custom benchmark automated with pytest. Integrated Gemini and Groq APIs with evidence-sufficiency checks, citation validation, contradiction detection, deterministic fallbacks and an authenticated document management panel.

projects.name: Chess Master
projects.description: Built a real-time multiplayer chess platform using Node.js, Express.js, and Socket.IO, featuring Elo rating calculations, skill-based matchmaking, server-side move validation, AI opponents and 60-second disconnection recovery. Used MongoDB compound and TTL indexes with atomic conditional updates to prevent race conditions. Includes 15+ RESTful APIs, paginated game history, JWT and Google OAuth authentication.

projects.name: ShopLix
projects.description: Full-stack e-commerce application with 15 RESTful APIs, Mongoose data models, referenced user-order relationships, embedded order snapshots and Mongoose Map-based cart management. Includes product filtering, sorting, pagination, JWT authentication, RBAC, Google OAuth 2.0, Cloudinary image uploads and Nodemailer order notifications.

points: Coordinated 3 electronics workshops with 100+ participants each, managing venue planning, resources and on-ground logistics.
